video_title: GREATEST COMEBACK EVER!! Game 4 REACTION: Knicks’ Epic Comeback To Beat Spurs

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' recent playoff comebacks show they never give up
quotes.excerpt: they've conditioned their crowd to never give up
quotes.quote: This is the fifth Knicks comeback in the playoffs of over 20 points in the last two years. So they've conditioned their crowd to never give up.

quotes.speaker: Ben McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks are the ultimate NBA cockroaches
quotes.excerpt: they are the ultimate NBA cockroaches. You can't just step on them. You got to squish them
quotes.quote: The Knicks, and I mean this as a compliment, they are the ultimate NBA cockroaches. You can't just step on them. You got to squish them and then you got to flush them. Like they do not die.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's lack of involvement in the second half
quotes.excerpt: the youngest guy on the court was the guy who needed the ball. And he didn't get
quotes.quote: The only guy who had any sort of juice going at all in the second half was Dylan Harper. And he vanished into the woodwork. Frankly, the youngest guy on the court was the guy who needed the ball. And he didn't get the ball.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson's usage of Victor Wembanyama was inexcusable
quotes.excerpt: Mitch Johnson was inexcusable with his usage of Victor Wembanyama in this game
quotes.quote: Mitch Johnson was inexcusable with his usage of Victor Wembanyama in this game. He was completely on empty the entire fourth quarter, and so he was oftentimes standing there on the perimeter, watching straight-line drives to the rim for layups and kickouts for threes.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's maturity and emotional control
quotes.excerpt: there's a streak of immaturity in Victor Wembanyama. For all of his attributes, he's got a streak
quotes.quote: There's a streak of immaturity in Victor Wembanyama. For all of his attributes, and all of the things he does that are great, and all of his great aspects of his mental game, he's got a streak of immaturity and he showed it with that whole act out there.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado as a chaotic agent on the court
quotes.excerpt: Jose Alvarado is a complete chaos agent. Sometimes it's good, frankly a lot of times it's pretty bad
quotes.quote: Jose Alvarado is a complete chaos agent. Sometimes it's good, frankly a lot of times it's pretty bad. And he just gets over half court. He actually never got over half court. His body comes over half court, the ball never comes over half court.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's ball-handling issues and lack of secondary playmakers
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson pounding the ball too much is there are not a lot of secondary ball handlers
quotes.quote: Part of the reason Jalen Brunson pounds the ball too much is there are not a lot of secondary ball handlers on the team. If you have Landry Shamet out there, or Deuce McBride out there, or a bunch of these different guys, even Mikal Bridges, none of them are really good ball handlers to sort of take over the offense.
